actors.name: Marine Le Pen
actors.role: Leader of Rassemblement National in France
actors.blurb: Marine Le Pen generated widespread international coverage by offering to meet Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Brussels while maintaining her opposition to financial aid for Kyiv. She also faced heavy confrontation and protests during a campaign appearance at the Made in France trade expo as positioning for the 2027 presidential election intensifies.

actors.name: Jair Bolsonaro
actors.blurb: Jair Bolsonaro remains a central subject of legal and political turmoil in Brazil as the Prosecutor-General (PGR) formally opposed reviewing his 27-year prison conviction. Concurrently, Supreme Court judges issued decisions regarding his past blocking of journalists on social media and demanded detailed security logs from the Cabinet of Institutional Security (GSI).

actors.name: Giorgia Meloni
actors.blurb: Giorgia Meloni reversed proposed budget cuts to education while asserting Italy's diplomatic role at the European Political Community summit in Dublin, where she met with Volodymyr Zelenskyy. She also sent high-profile campaign endorsements to Spain's Vox rally while negotiating domestic bank tax framework adjustments.

actors.name: Javier Milei
actors.blurb: Javier Milei sparked international debate by sending an aggressive campaign video message to Vox leader Santiago Abascal in Spain calling to end 'damned socialism', triggering counterattacks from Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez. Regionally, Milei held bilateral talks to reinforce ties with Paraguay's incoming administration while defending his free-market reforms.

actors.name: Karol Nawrocki
actors.role: Presidential candidate and Opposition figure in Poland
actors.blurb: Karol Nawrocki escalated a constitutional standoff in Poland by vetoing the EU Digital Services Act (DSA) implementation bill for a second time, citing protection against 'communist-era censorship'. His decision drew intense criticism from Prime Minister Donald Tusk's cabinet alongside disputes over presidential powers and citizenship rulings.
